limitations.note: The rewrite stopped green from repeatedly reloading, but it also asserted red during reset and removed the original startup delay instead of preserving both behaviors with a one-line fix to green's rising-edge check.
The replacement kept the ports but removed the four public state parameters, so an existing instantiation that overrides them would no longer compile.
The test required the rewrite's immediate-red reset behavior, so its passing result could not catch the regression in reset and startup timing.
The Git status check failed because the workspace was not a Git repository and yielded no information useful to the fix.
